versions.changelog:
Initial release of poka-yoke-design skill for proactive poka-yoke (mistake-proofing) solution design:

- Provides a structured, stepwise process for engineers to design effective poka-yoke solutions based on E-R-F-D-M principles and ten classic methods.
- Requires users to clarify problems and error modes; enforces interaction locks to ensure critical inputs before generating solutions.
- Outputs multi-solution tables with effectiveness ranking ("not made > not passed > not accepted") and rationale to support selection.
- Covers both design and production stage error-proofing; includes hands-on templates in TXT and Markdown for direct implementation.
- Clearly defines capability boundaries; avoids generating incomplete or unsubstantiated recommendations.
- Includes comprehensive internal references and integration suggestions with related skills (e.g., FMEA, 5Why, QRQC).
